source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: أول يوم بالشغل، كنت خايف شوي.
sentences.en: On my first day at work, I was a bit scared.

sentences.ar: صحيت بكير ولبست أحسن أواعي عندي.
sentences.en: I woke up early and put on my best clothes.

sentences.ar: وصلت المكتب قبل الوقت بنص ساعة.
sentences.en: I got to the office half an hour early.
The manager welcomed me and introduced me to the employees.
They were all kind and helped me a lot.

sentences.ar: بالأول ما كنت بعرف وين الأشيا.
sentences.en: At first I didn't know where things were.
But after a while, I got used to the work.

sentences.ar: بوقت الغدا، قعدت مع زملائي وحكينا.
sentences.en: At lunchtime, I sat with my colleagues and we talked.

sentences.ar: آخر النهار، حسيت إني تعلمت كتير.
sentences.en: At the end of the day, I felt I had learned a lot.
I went home happy and excited for tomorrow.
